answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the timber queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 403 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sparrow. A farm of 56 pays that 225 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
